youtube_description:
Day 1 of AAS 241, the first full day of astronomy and science at the big American Astronomical Society meeting! Today felt like a giant family reunion, full of my FAVORITE people in the world: Astronomers!

Also tune in for my exclusive interview with Night Lunch, Seattle's only all-astronomer band! These folks have been rocking since they were all grad students here, and you can catch them Tuesday Jan 10 at 8pm at The Sunset in Ballard
https://twitter.com/nightlunchband
